{{Quote|Itsa Boss Lyonie, hesa alive....|The Gungan upon seeing Jar Jar Binks disguised as Boss Lyonie|<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>}}
This '''Gungan warrior''' was an [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who served in the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] as a [[Militiagung/Legends|Militiagung]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
The Gungan was present near [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] when [[Minister]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] announced that [[Boss/Legends|boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]] was dead and had told the Gungan Army that they should honor his last order which was to continue their attack against Naboo and march alongside the [[Droid Army]] on [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

After seeing [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] disguised as Boss Lyonie, this Gungan announced everyone that Lyonie was still alive. Rish Loo, amazed to see the Gungan still standing, stood confused as Jar Jar exposed his plan and cancelled the attack. The Gungan and the rest of the army then started to go against Rish Loo as he drove away in his [[Flitknot speeder/Legends|speeder]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] started chasing him while riding a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]].

Meanwhile, as the Gungan army stayed behind, the droid army along with their leader, [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]], came to talk about the canceled attack on Theed. After a disguised Jar Jar talked with the general, this Gungan and the others disabled his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army and when Grievous realized who Jar Jar actually was, this Gungan along with the others helped capture him.
